aggregate_exposure: Only four per-SNR conventional/NeuralRx totals printed by the unchanged generator; no individual feature or CRC record was inspected before this freeze.
q_model_selection: Five-fold C77-training-only grid selection; 16x4 chosen by minimum CV rescue Brier subject to every fold leaf n>=100. C77 test and C94 are development evidence, not Confirm102 selection inputs.
timing_provenance: Admission uses C100 declared bounds. Replay uses values rounded above C100 observed maxima for NRx (14.562->15) and conventional (5.251->6); AI replay 22 ms approximates the two C100 medians 21.650/21.498 while admission retains 50 ms. Replay constants are not new bounds or WCET evidence.
online_information: At radio decision only five release-0 AI jobs and train-only feature predictions are visible. AI5/AI6 future arrivals, CRC outcomes, and future service times are hidden. Each event commits one nonpreemptive action then replans.
proposed: Max-radio-relative guarded joint policy: require q_gain >= max(original radio floor, max-radio q_gain-0.01), then maximize expected visible timely AI; exact small-state reference and add/drop/1-swap implementation share the same all-fail evaluator.

baselines.low_gate: Confirm60 train-only low channel-power threshold; among eligible cells q-rank to the same two endpoints; exact online recovery/AI recourse.
baselines.staged_min: Minimum NRx cardinality meeting the original q floor, maximize q within that cardinality, then exact online recovery/AI recourse.
baselines.max_radio: Maximize q over all safe subsets, then exact online recovery/AI recourse.
baselines.joint_greedy: Unconstrained AI-first add/drop/1-swap under the original q floor and identical all-fail evaluator.
baselines.exact_reference: Full subset enumeration inside the max-radio-relative q guard.

ablations.always_mandatory: Force every cell conventional obligation to remain even after NeuralRx success; require zero capacity span across NRx subsets.
ablations.uniform_q: Replace per-cell q by a common batch mean capped by min p; report selection difference.
ablations.packing_control: All AI jobs have identical bound, replay duration, deadline, and value, so a heterogeneous knapsack gap cannot explain a difference.

frozen_validity_gates: Model support >=0.95, independent q Brier better than the train-prevalence constant, q weighted MACE <=0.03, >=30 feasible quartets, no branch safety failure, guarded exact and guarded 1-swap select identically, always-mandatory ablation span zero for every feasible case, and per-case predicted q loss versus max-radio <=0.01.
frozen_positive_outcome_gate: For a positive CPU policy witness, proposed total realized timely AI must exceed both max-radio and staged-min, while total realized correct TB must be no lower than either. Zero or negative remains negative. A pass is still only an independent synthetic-PHY deterministic CPU replay and requires paired GPU and actual AI-RAN workload validation.
